mapper.select: SELECT base_name AS baseName, active_report_id AS activeReportId FROM report_version_sequence WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE report_version_sequence SET base_name = #{baseName}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND base_name IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_report_email_log WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND status = 'SENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_version_sequence (tenant_id, client, subbarcode, template_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.tenantId}, #{row.client}, #{row.subbarcode}, #{row.templateId}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.update: UPDATE report_version_sequence SET active_report_id = #{reportId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND (active_report_id IS NULL OR active_report_id = #{reportId})

UPDATE analysis_report SET report_version = #{row.reportVersion}, report_sequence_id = #{row.sequenceId}, template_id = #{row.templateId}, report_generation_no = report_generation_no + 1, report_reviewer_id = COALESCE(report_reviewer_id, report_checked_by), report_checked_by = NULL, report_checked_at = NULL, report_review_claimed_by = NULL, report_review_claimed_at = NULL, report_sign_flow_no = NULL, report_sign_started_at = NULL, report_sign_time = NULL, report_signed_file_path = NULL, report_sign_fail_reason = NULL, report_gen_fail_reason = NULL, report_status = 31, update_time = NOW() WHERE report_id = #{row.reportId} AND del_flag = '0' AND report_status IN (31, 32, 33, 52)

UPDATE report_version_sequence s JOIN analysis_report r ON r.report_sequence_id = s.id AND r.tenant_id = s.tenant_id SET s.sent_version = r.report_version, s.active_report_id = NULL, s.update_time = NOW() WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId} AND s.active_report_id = r.report_id AND r.report_version = s.sent_version + 1 AND r.report_status IN (60, 61)
UPDATE analysis_report SET report_status = 62, report_sent_by = #{userId}, report_sent_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND del_flag = '0' AND report_status IN (60, 61)

UPDATE analysis_report SET report_status = CASE WHEN #{reviewerId} IS NULL THEN 40 ELSE 41 END, report_review_claimed_by = #{reviewerId}, report_review_claimed_at = CASE WHEN #{reviewerId} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE NOW() END, update_time = NOW() WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND del_flag = '0' AND report_status = 32
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role role ON role.role_id = ur.role_id AND role.status = '0' AND role.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = role.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu m ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status = '0' AND u.del_flag = '0' AND (u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR u.tenant_id = '000000') AND (u.user_id = 1 OR role.role_key = 'superadmin' OR m.perms = 'report:interpretation:review')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_file_status WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND del_flag = '0' AND (status IS NULL OR status != 'Loaded')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_file_status WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT report_id FROM analysis_report WHERE source_report_id = #{sourceReportId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY report_id DESC LIMIT 1
